reasoning: Assigning 17 pigeons to 16 holes with at most one pigeon per hole requires an injective mapping from a set of size 17 to a set of size 16, which is impossible by the pigeonhole principle.
cot_trace: Impossible: 17 pigeons, 16 holes, each hole at most one pigeon, need injective mapping from 17 to 16 impossible. So UNSAT.
